procedural_matters: The panel of the international jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
facts: After race 5, in the Men's Yellow fleet, the TC inspected BAH 198661.
BAH 198661 did not have a colored band that indicated to which fleet she was assigned.
Before the race, BAH 198661 had attached the colored band to her mast.
Approximately 2 minutes before the starting signal of the race, the colored band began to detach from the mast.
BAH 198661 removed the colored band from the mast and threw it to the nearby vessel that was supporting BAH
The support vessel was approximately 2 meters away from BAH 198661 at that moment.
The colored band landed inside the support vessel.
conclusions: By not racing with the required colored band for her fleet in race 5, BAH 198661 broke SI 3.1.
By discarding the colored band into the support vessel that was supporting BAH 198661, BAH 198661 received outside help and broke rule 41.
